judge.comments: Comprehensive report covering purpose, architecture, entry points, risks, and contribution paths, with strong grounding (18/18 citations verified) and plausible technical claims. Minor coverage gap: several subcommands (confirm, input, write, format, log) are not profiled as core modules, though they appear in the tech stack/dependencies. Actionability is excellent with concrete file-level tasks and mitigations, and the reading order + unknowns give a newcomer a clear path into the codebase.
